en.topic_title: World News Day: Why independent journalism is a lifeline for Hong Kong
en.topic_summary:
HKFP is joining 1,000 news organisations across more than 100 countries to highlight World News Day on September 28. Coinciding with the UN International Day for Universal Access to Information, it aims to promote fact-based journalism, truth and media literacy across the world.



Quality journalism is critical to a society’s economy, national security, and response to crises.  This was the conclusion of a UNESCO-commissioned report published in June.
